* Reflection-based {@link PSKKeyManager} adaptor for objects which expose all the methods of the * {@code PSKKeyManager} interface but do not implement the interface. * *

This is expected to be useful on platforms where there are multiple instances of the * {@code PSKKeyManager} interface. * * Visible for testing only. * * @deprecated This abstraction is deprecated because it does not work with TLS 1.3.

methods.comment:
* Gets an instance of {@code DuckTypedPSKKeyManager} which delegates all invocations of methods
     * of the {@link PSKKeyManager} interface to the same methods of the provided object.
     *
     * @throws NoSuchMethodException if {@code obj} does not implement a method of the
     *         {@code PSKKeyManager} interface.
